versions.changelog:
- Updated migration information to point to the new skill location: https://clawhub.ai/vibevideo/vibevideo-core.
- Updated links and instructions to reflect the new destination.

Major update: The vibevideo-io skill has been migrated.

- All related files and documentation have been removed.
- The skill now advises users to use https://clawhub.ai/brainchen/vibevideo-core instead.
- Old project functionality and CLI commands are no longer available in this version.
- The SKILL.md has been replaced with a migration notice and updated links.

v1.0.0 (Initial Release)

- Introduces VibeVideo Studio Bridge for direct OpenClaw integration with bollo.video and vibevideo.io.
- Supports logging in with email verification (including CAPTCHA), listing Studio projects (with links), creating video episodes from scripts, and logging out.
- Automatically selects the login site based on user language or explicit preference.
- Provides detailed CLI commands and multi-turn login flow for handling CAPTCHA and verification steps.
- Ensures secure handling and delivery of CAPTCHA images, especially on non-webchat chat surfaces.
- Includes clear routing triggers for various video creation and Studio access intents.
